wake_test.sequence: VM state paused -> BFF GET /v5/vms/{id} -> POST /start -> POST /exec-await "sudo -n docker restart campus-pathway-worker" -> run claimed
wake_test.note: 只 start 不 restart 时，旧进程可能带着 stale idle clock 立即再次 pause；因此唤醒时显式重启 worker 容器。

billing_note: 按 Freestyle 官方 Pricing：paused VM 不保留 compute reservation，只计 storage；Free 每月 60,000 GiB-hour storage 包含量，32GB 常驻远低于额度。
logs: freestyle_pause_connection_closed/failed after freeze (expected; pause still took effect)
caveat: pause 请求可能因 VM 立即冻结而超时；worker 将超时/连接中断视为已请求暂停。若未生效会继续轮询，不丢任务。
